The Kubernetes Gateway API is a role-oriented, extensible API for managing ingress and mesh traffic routing in Kubernetes clusters. It introduces the GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute, and GRPCRoute resources that collectively provide advanced traffic management features including header-based routing, traffic weighting, cross-namespace routing, and multi-protocol support as a successor to the Ingress API.
